## DPStyleARWebLive.deinitialize() method

Deinitialize StyleAR and release all allocated resources. This method waits for any in-progress start/stop operations, stops active camera and processing modules if needed, and then deinitializes the internal StyleAR manager.

**Signature:**

```typescript
deinitialize(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when deinitialization is complete.
